caseName: Lindsey v. United States Bureau of Prisons
caseNameFull: Lindsey v. United States Bureau of Prisons

opinions.text: C. A. 11th Cir. Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis and certiorari granted. Judgment vacated and case remanded for further consideration in light of the Solicitor General's present interpretation of Fed. Rule Crim. Proc. 32 asserted in his brief filed November 14, 1984, on behalf of respondents.
